content: RFC 9700 (OAuth 2.0 Security BCP, IETF, Jan 2025): For confidential clients, PKCE is RECOMMENDED (not just for public clients) and also prevents CSRF as a side effect. State parameter or PKCE MUST be used for CSRF protection on the redirect endpoint. Clients MUST NOT expose open redirectors. Authorization servers MUST use exact string matching for redirect_uri (no wildcard patterns). nonce parameter in OIDC also provides CSRF/injection protection when combined with proper ID token validation.
